title: Class-Structure Preservation Beats Diversity: A Comprehensive Benchmark of Text Augmentation Methods for Imbalanced Text Classification
abstract: arXiv:2608.12340v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: With the rapid advancement of large language models (LLMs), generative data augmentation has attracted considerable attention for imbalanced text classification in natural language processing. However, no empirical benchmark to date has compared LLM-based augmentation against the embedding-space SMOTE-style retrieval (EmbSMOTE), a strong classical reference for imbalanced classification. In this study, a controlled benchmark of 11 augmentation methods, spanning classical perturbation, embedding-space retrieval, and LLM-based generation, is newly constructed on seven public text classification datasets covering class counts $K=2$-$28$ and imbalance ratios of 1.1 to over 500, evaluated with five random seeds per cell using macro F1, Welch's $t$-tests, five distributional metrics, and an LLM-family sensitivity analysis based on Qwen3-8B. The experimental results reveal that all LLM-based methods are statistically equivalent or inferior to E

translated_title: 类别结构保持优于多样性：面向不平衡文本分类的文本增强方法综合基准研究
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.12340v1 公告类型：新 摘要：随着大语言模型（LLMs）的快速发展，生成式数据增强在自然语言处理中的不平衡文本分类任务中引起了广泛关注。然而，迄今为止尚无实证基准将基于LLM的增强方法与嵌入空间SMOTE式检索（EmbSMOTE）这一不平衡分类的强经典参考方法进行比较。本研究构建了一个包含11种增强方法的受控基准，涵盖经典扰动、嵌入空间检索和基于LLM的生成方法，在七个公开文本分类数据集上进行了测试，这些数据集覆盖类别数量K=2至28以及不平衡比率从1.1到超过500，每种情况使用五个随机种子进行评估，评估指标包括宏F1、Welch t检验、五种分布度量，以及基于Qwen3-8B的LLM家族敏感性分析。实验结果表明，所有基于LLM的方法在统计上等同于或劣于EmbSMOTE。
tldr: 本研究发现，在广泛的不平衡文本分类基准测试中，LLM生成式增强方法并未超越经典嵌入空间SMOTE式方法，类别结构保持比生成多样性更为关键。
en_tdlr: This study finds that LLM-based generative augmentation methods do not surpass the classical embedding-space SMOTE approach in a comprehensive imbalanced text classification benchmark, indicating that class-structure preservation is more critical than generation diversity.
